chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Akhi Hammad al-Katib, from al-Husayn ibn Abdullah, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: 'Was the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله the master of the children of Adam?' He said: 'By Allah, he was the master of all whom Allah created, and Allah did not create any creature better than Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله.'

key_terms.سَيِّدَ: master, chief, or foremost in rank
key_terms.مَنْ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ: those whom Allah created, meaning all created beings
key_terms.مُحَمَّدٍ: the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله, identified here as the best of creation
key_terms.وُلْدِ آدَمَ: the children of Adam, meaning humankind

ai.seo_question: Was the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله the greatest of all Allah’s creation?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the supreme rank of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله over all creation, not only over the children of Adam. It presents his excellence as absolute among created beings and thus highlights his unique status in Shia theology and prophetic tradition.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Bin Akhy Hammad Al Katib Al Husayn Bin Abdullah who said

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Was Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> the chief of the children of Adam<sup>as</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! He<sup>saww</sup> was the chief of the ones Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has no created being better than Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. md ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad son of the brother of Hammad al-Katib from al-Husayn ibn ‘Abdallah who has said the following.

“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘Was the Messenger of Allah the mater of the children of Adam?” The Imam (a.s.) said, ‘By Allah, he was the master of all whom Allah has created. Allah has not created any creature better than Muhammad (s.a.).”
